Commentary.Commentary: So that completes our formalities for this match. The series has become more interesting now and Pakistan have bounced back hard after having a nightmarish tour so far. They would look to repeat the tale of MCG but they would have to deal against a charged up Australian side. The third ODI is set to take place at the WACA, Perth on 19th of January at 0850 IST (0320 GMT). We have a cracker of a contest on our hands, do join us for that. Meanwhile, do tune in for the India and England match that is going on. Till then, adios and take care!

Pakistan skipper and Man of the Match, Mohammad Hafeez feels that the boys did a great job. Adds that their batsmen played well as the ball was not coming on to the bat and the bowlers did the job too. Adds that Malik bowled well and he is an experienced player. He finished it in the end. Mentions that they love the Pakistani crowd and they love them too. Says that they have won this for Pakistan.

Australia skipper, Steven Smith says they were below par with the bat in today's game, just like in the first game as well. Adds that had it not been for Matthew Wade who bailed them out of trouble, they would have been in some serious trouble (In the first game). States that they lost wickets in clumps and they need to give themselves a better chance. Acknowledges that they struggled against the Pakistan spinners to play their natural game and build partnerships, which is something they would like to change in the next match. Admits that they tried their best till the end and never stopped believing, but Pakistan were too good for them on the day. Feels that his side was probably 40 runs short and that put too much pressure on the bowlers. Credits his bowlers for bowling the way they performed and kept the pressure on the opposition. (On Chris Lynn's fitness) Says that they will have to wait and see to assess whether he will travel with the squad to Perth. He ends by saying that he hopes to get a nice, bouncy wicket at Perth and that they can do well there.

Shoaib Malik played a confident knock down the order and settled the nerves after the tourists lost Azam and Hafeez in quick succession. Starc, Faulkner and Hazlewood were great with the ball but is was a too low target to defend. Earlier, Steven Smith was the only one who played a responsible knock and scored a fighting half century for the home side. The Pakistani bowlers were right on the money and strangled the Aussie batsmen to a low total. Junaid Khan and Mohammad Amir were terrific with the ball for the visitors and gave their batters a real shot at victory. In the end, they backed the effort of their bowlers to get to glory.

That's it, the long wait for Pakistan comes to an end. They have broken the drought after almost 12 years and have cruised to a comfortable victory against Australia as they have leveled the series 1-1. The steady and crucial 68-run opening stand between Sharjeel and Hafeez set it up nicely for the visitors and the rest cashed in to see them through at the end. Hafeez played a terrific knock today and led by example to score a patient 72. The hosts would be ruing the fact that they dropped him for a duck and the Professor made them pay big time.

Wide! A rather anti-climatic way to win but Pakistan will take it nevertheless. Head from around the wicket darts it down the leg side, Umar Akmal just leaves it alone. So with that, PAKISTAN WIN THIS MATCH BY 6 WICKETS!

FOUR! THEY'RE ALMOST HOME! Full toss on off, Umar Akmal hammers his back down the ground for a boundary. Almost took off his partner's head with that but the two of them are all smiles anyway. Just one run needed to win now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Makes great use of his feet and gets it away. Gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it ever so well over extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter one from Head, Akmal defends.
Another back foot defense from Shoaib Malik to end the over.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angles it in on middle and leg, strikes Malik on the thigh pad as he looks to play at it.
Fuller on off, Akmal gives it the full swing of the bat but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads and then it rolls over to the leg side. A single is taken.
Stays back to this back of a length delivery and keeps it out on the off side.
Back of a length outside off, misses as he attempts to cut square on the off side.

Almost a catch. Would have been a difficult one to take. Shoaib Malik pulls this off his back foot past the diving mid-wicket fielder. David Warner out in the deep does well to comes across and cut it off with a dive. Two runs are taken.
Finds the gap this time. Akmal goes back to this flat and short delivery to whip it in front of square. A single taken.
Four in a row. Works it straight to short mid-wicket.
Three dots in a row. Head tosses it up on the stumps, it's played back to the bowler.
Full outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up around off, blocked off the front foot.
Travis Head to bowl now. 13 runs needed off 30 balls. Can he do something magical?
Shoaib Malik has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good piece of fielding from David Warner. Akmal drives it to the left of mid off where Warner makes a good diving stop. Only a single taken.
FOUR! Just banged that. Went dead straight and executed it extremely well. Overpitched outside off, Umar Akmal drives it aerially back down and sends it one bounce across the long off boundary.
Brings his bat ahead of his pad and plays it back down the track.
Another solid defense. Akmal stands his ground and keeps it out.
From around the wicket, Akmal defends this length ball from Faulkner with a straight bat.
James Faulkner is back into the attack.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid on for no run. Pakistan need 18 in 36.
FOUR! WHAT. A. SHOT. Hit that with absolute disdain, didn't he? Back of a length around off, Malik gets on top of the bounce and thumps the pull over mid-wicket to send it across the fence.
Full outside off, Malik with that straight blade again. Drives it back down to mid off.

Good shot. Gets it in the gap nicely, the placement was fine. Length ball outside off, Umar Akmal cuts it down on the ground on the off side. It pierces the gap in the covers and three runs are taken.
Back of a length on off, Akmal hangs back, hops and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Short of a length angling in, easily tucked down to fine leg by Shoaib Malik. One run taken.

Comes from around the wicket for the final ball of the over, it's speared full outside off, Umar Akmal looks to push it from inside the line but is beaten past his outside edge. That's the end of Starc's stint with the ball.
Umar Akmal comes out to bat.

OUT! That's an edge which is taken! A needless shot from Asad Shafiq, was no need to go after it. Starc fires it full and well outside off, Shafiq goes after it still for some reason and gets a nick on it. Easy take for Matthew Wade behind the stumps who makes no mistake in gobbling it up. Another 26 runs needed from 43 balls.
On the fuller side once more, Shoaib mistimes his drive down towards mid off and a single is taken.
Fires it right up there again, outside off, Malik pushes it through the gap in the covers and picks up a couple of runs.
Fuller length delivery from Starc, kept out off the front foot.

Not out! Full ball aimed at the base of off stump, Shafiq drives it towards mid-wicket and sets off. Hazlewood gets a direct hit at the bowler's end as Shafiq slides his bat in. It goes upstairs and replays show that Asad was well in. Good running.
A run out appeal against Asad Shafiq is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Shoaib Malik has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 30 more runs needed for Pakistan to win off 48 balls.
Wide! Short and going down leg, Malik looks to go after it but can't reach it. Wide called.
Fractionally fuller in length, around the off stump, it's defended off the front foot and into the track.
Shortish delivery pitched outside off, Malik looks to slash it hard towards third man but cannot make any contact.
Wide! Mitchell Marsh brings out the short one and pounds the deck hard, but it's too high for the umpire's liking so he signals it as a wide.
Angles it into the body, Shafiq works it round the corner and takes a run.
Stays within his crease and does well to keep it out.
Back of a length outside off, Malik opens the face and runs it down to third man for an easy single.
Yorker outside off, Asad jams it down by sticking his bat out to it.
Slants across a length ball outside off, left alone.
A bit of a mishap from David Warner and that allows the batsmen to take the extra run. Shafiq pushes this towards mid off and the ball goes off Warner's hand as he dives to stop it. Two runs taken.
Fuller on the stumps, it's worked in front of mid-wicket for a quick single.
Fuller length ball from Mitchell Starc, Malik defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on the hips, it's glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled by the umpire. Meanwhile, Mitchell Starc comes back to bowl.
Fullish on off, dropped in front of covers off the front foot. 38 needed off 60.

FOUR! That has been hit beautifully. Shots don't get any better than that. Marsh overpitches it on middle and off, Shoaib Malik leans into the drive and hits it right back down the ground. That will race away to the boundary line.
Walks a step across to this length delivery and meets it with a straight blade.
Similar delivery, Malik pushes it back out on the off side.
Fuller around off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Very good shot! That should relieve some pressure. Short and wide outside off, enough room for Malik to free his arms and he does so. Slashes it over point and sends it across the ropes for a boundary.
Mitchell Marsh is back on.
Comfortably done. Malik runs this down to third man rather easily and will retain strike. Pakistan need 46 more from 66 balls.
Streaky runs. Asad Shafiq leans ahead and reaches out to play at it. Gets a thick edge which runs down to third man. A run taken.
Fuller length ball around off, punched straight to David Warner at wide mid off.
Jags back in a touch after hitting the deck, catches the inside edge of Shafiq's bat and hits him on the thigh pad.
Stays right behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out rather solidly.
Loud shout for a leg before but that's turned down. Rightly so, it was always going down leg. Angles back in and catches Asad Shafiq on the front pad.
Full and coming in on the pads, Shafiq flicks it through backward square leg. Will get three runs for it. 48 needed off 72 to win.

ALMOST DRAGGED IT BACK ON! Length ball around off, Shoaib Malik looks to cut it on the off side but is cramped for room and gets an inside edge which goes just past the leg stump. It goes down to fine leg and a single is taken.
Works this away on the leg side for a couple of good runs.
Big swing and a big miss! Length ball outside off, Malik flashes his bat hard at this but fails to make any connection.

NOT OUT! A waste of a review in hindsight, really. It was always missing the stumps. Although, it's understandable, the desperation for a wicket. Angles in a back of a length delivery from around off, it catches Malik on the pads and the Aussies go up for a leg before appeal. The decision goes upstairs as Steven Smith decides to review it. Replays show that height was an issue. Tough luck, Steven.
Australia have taken a review against Malik. It is regarding an LBW decision. Looked like height was a factor there.
Taps this length delivery to covers and takes a quick single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bit fuller in length around off, kept out off the front foot and into the track.

SIX! OH SHOAIB MALIK, YOU BEAUTY! What a shot to hit under pressure. He was waiting a long time for that from Josh Hazlewood and he's made full use of it. Full on the stumps, Malik with perfect balance and an excellent straight bat, lofts this back down the ground. Clears the rope easily and that will be a biggie.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT! Risky, risky stuff from the Pakistan duo here. Shafiq closes the face early and gets a leading edge towards extra cover. Warner comes charging towards the ball and fires a throw at the striker's end. Misses by just that much. Had he hit, Shoaib Malik would have been gone. Single completed.

It was in the air but it fell just short! Asad Shafiq rocks back to this back of a length delivery and miscues his pull shot horribly. It lobs over towards Khawaja at short mid-wicket but it falls short of him as he dives forward to take it.
Full on the stumps, Shafiq drives it to mid on.
Fuller length ball coming in, Malik picks it off his pads and works it to mid-wicket. Pakistan need 62 to win off 84 deliveries.
Cummins brings out the short one and hits the deck hard, Shoaib Malik ducks and evades.
Length delivery outside off, driven through the cover region for a couple of runs.

NOT OUT! SHOAIB MALIK SURVIVES! This could be the potential game changer for Pakistan. Pat Cummins however, what a ripper of a delivery. He bowls this on a back of a length just around off, Malik hangs his bat out to this and the ball goes behind into the keeper's gloves. There's some noise though and Australia are immediately up. The umpire raises his finger but Malik asks for the decision to be reviewed. And nicely done, though. Replays show that the noise came from the bat hitting the pad. He lives to fight on.
Shoaib Malik has been caught behind and given out. The Pakistan veteran however feels he hasn't got any bat on that. Let's see what the replays show. Big moment in the game...
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot on the off side.
FOUR! Think Shoaib Malik has had enough. He goes at this and goes hard. It's a bit too wide and it's enough for him to slash it through cover-point for a boundary.
Angling in on a back of a length, kept out from deep within his crease off the back foot.
Gets a run this time. Pushes it back down the track and scurries to the other end.
On the fuller side once more, on middle and off, it's once again driven back to Hazlewood.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven to Mitchell Starc at mid on. He gets a direct hit at the bowler's end but Shafiq was inside his crease.
Another full ball from Hazlewood, it's driven straight back to him.
Spears it full around off, Malik leans ahead and keeps it out.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Full on the stumps, it's flicked to the mid-wicket region. Another dot ball and that brings an end to an electrifying over from Pat Cummins.
Rock Solid from Asad Shafiq. He stands firm, leans ahead and meets it with a solid, straight blade.
Another edge. But this one is much safer. On a length around off, takes the edge and goes down to third man for a single.

FOUR! And edge which hasn't carried! How unfortunate is that for Pat Cummins? Length delivery angling in from around off, Malik hangs his bat out to this and he gets a healthy edge. It flies behind but falls short of Mitchell Marsh at first slip. It goes through him and that will be a boundary.
Moving away from the batsman, it's tapped in front of covers off the back foot.
Angling in on middle and leg, there's some extra bounce off the deck as the ball raps Shoaib Malik on the thigh pad after taking the inside edge.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.

Length ball on leg, goes off Malik's pads as he attempts to flick. It goes towards backward square leg and the batsmen are playing it risky here. They run for the second as there is a shy at the striker's end. That misses and so, the Pakistan batsmen take one more. Three leg byes in total. 75 more needed to win from 102 balls.
Shaping away a shade after pitching on middle and leg, at 142 kph, it's kept out from deep within the crease by Shoaib Malik.
Length delivery angled across, Malik drives it straight to cover-point.
Another play and a miss! Mitchell Starc using that angle well and he's bowling brilliantly. Slants it across outside off, Shoaib Malik looks to play this inside the line but misses.

Another full one outside off, Asad Shafiq drives it towards extra cover and sets off for the run. David Warner gets to the ball, positions himself to fire the throw but then pulls up right at the last second. Not sure what exactly but the batsmen are able to take a single.
Hurls in a fuller ball wide outside off, Shafiq looks to put bat on ball but is unable to do so.
Fires it full outside off, Shoaib Malik leans across and blocks it off the front foot.
Shoaib Malik strides out to bat. The Pakistanis are still in a comfortable position but you never know with them. They might be cruising through but may collapse down like a pack of cards suddenly.

OUT! The change of angle has done the trick and James Faulkner has struck gold. Comes from around the wicket and angles in a fuller ball from around off, Hafeez leans across and lofts it off the toe end towards mid on. The ball stops on the track a bit and that does him in. Hazlewood settles himself under it and takes the easiest of catches.
Angles across a length delivery, Shafiq opens the face and guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Asad Shafiq stands his ground and keeps it down on the track right under his nose.
Slants across a fuller length ball, well outside off, Shafiq reaches out to it to cut it away but fails to make connection.
Fuller length ball outside off, Hafeez leans across and pushes it square through backward point for a single.
Full delivery wide outside off, Asad lets it go through. A wicket and 5 runs off that over.
Starc is on the charge. Bowls almost a yorker length ball outside off, Shafiq jams it out.
Well bowled! Hurls in a yorker on the stumps, Shafiq is alert to it and digs it out nicely.
Asad Shafiq is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Azam departs! The brilliant 72-run stand comes to an end. He tried this shot a few times earlier too but this time it brings his downfall. Bowls a shortish delivery outside off, Azam looks to ramp it over the third man fence but fails to get the desired elevation. It flies towards Hazlewood at third man. He moves to his left and takes a good catch. The visitors are still in the driver's seat and need 81 off 117 balls with 8 wickets still in the tank.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Mohammad slashes at it but gets a thick edge towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Hafeez is on the charge! Fullish delivery outside off, Hafeez drives it uppishly with an open face through cover-point and the ball whistles away to the fence.
FOUR! Sheer class! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azam leans forward and creams it elegantly through the covers for a terrific boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Well bowled! On a length outside off, Hafeez pokes at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Fuller length ball outside off, tapped towards point.
Bowls an off cutter outside off, Hafeez looks to steer it but misses it.
Slower ball at 122.3 clicks outside off, defended towards mid off of the front foot.
FOUR! Streaky but handy! Bowls a shortish delivery wide outside off, Azam slashes at it but gets an outside edge over the slip region and the ball races to the third man fence.
Full and straight this time, Mohammad clips it uppishly over square leg and gets three runs for it.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Bowls a fuller length ball outside off, Hafeez drives it with an open face and in between the fielders at cover-point and backward point. Gets another boundary to his name.
Short of a length delivery outside off, steered to third man for a run.
50-run stand between Hafeez and Azam!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Two runs added to the total.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. The hosts need 105 to win from 132 balls with nine wickets in hand.
Full and wide outside off, driven nicely through covers for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Dropped but what an effort from Cummins! He almost converted that into a catch! Hurls in a fuller length ball outside off, Hafeez drives it on the up over the covers. Cummins who is standing just outside the circle leaps full length and gets his fingertips to it but fails to grab it. Couple taken!
Leg bye! Straying on the pads, Azam looks to tuck it but misses and is struck on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Full length ball on the stumps, Azam closes his bat face early and looks to play it across but gets a leading edge back down the track.
James Faulkner returns.
Bowls a very full delivery well outside off, Hafeez looks to jam it out but misses. Smith goes up in an appeal but there was no edge on that one. The sound was of the bat hitting the ground.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven to mid off.
On a driving length wide outside off, Azam goes for a drive but gets a thick outside edge through gully. Single taken!

Great shot but even a better stop from Head at cover-point. Bowls a shortish delivery outside off, Azam pounces on it and cuts it hard towards Head. He dives athletically to his left and makes a stunning stop.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Bowls a short delivery into the stumps, Azam stands tall and pulls it hard over mid-wicket for a gorgeous boundary.
This was a touch risky but safe in the end. Decides to clip the fullish delivery uppishly through mid-wicket and gets it away from the fielder. Three runs taken!
Full length ball outside off, Hafeez leans ahead and drives it beautifully towards mid on but for no run.
Short of a length well outside off, steered to third man for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Fullish delivery at 140.9 clicks outside off, Azam drives it to mid off.
On a driving length wide outside off, Mohammad goes for an expansive drive but fails to make any contact.
Length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
On a length outside off, tapped towards covers. Both are ball watching and the throw is at the bowler's end but Azam gets back home safely.
Full length ball outside off, driven with an open face to point.
29th ODI Fifty for Mohammad Hafeez.

FOUR! What a way to reach his fifty! Bowls a fullish delivery on the pads, Hafeez clips it nonchalantly over square leg and the ball races to the fence. It has been a responsible knock from the stand-in Pakistani skipper and he is guiding them towards the target calmly.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
Short of a length ball on the hips, tucked nicely through backward square leg. This time they run hard between the wickets and come back for the second. Pakistan need 124 to win from 156 balls.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azam leans ahead and drives it beautifully down the ground. Good timing on that and Warner sprints after it from mid off to keep it down to two.
Short delivery wide outside off, cut hard to Maxwell at point.
Silly mid on comes in place.
The ball is holding up on the pitch. Hurls in a full length ball outside off, Babar lunges forward and mistimes it to mid off.
Azam looked to hit that fullish delivery hard but drags it off the inner half to mid on.
Back of a length well outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Azam stays well balanced and clips it elegantly through mid-wicket. Earns himself a boundary.
Fullish delivery tailing into Azam. He prods forward and pushes it to mid on.
Short of a length delivery angling in, Babar looks to pull it but gets hurried on. Gets hit on the thigh pad.
Good game awareness! Camps back to the back of a length delivery on  the stumps and tucks it with soft hands to short mid-wicket. Comes across for a quick single.
Good length delivery outside off, Mohammad covers the line and defends it solidly.
Full length ball on middle, driven firmly down towards mid on where Faulkner makes a good diving stop.
Mohammad Hafeez is once again getting his fingers taped. Some bandages on it seems so that he can continue. His index finger is fairly bruised.
That was smashed but really well fielded. Bangs in a shortish delivery outside off, Azam hangs back and flat bats it towards Cummins who bends low and picks it up in a jiffy.
Short of a length ball outside off, Mohammad steers it nicely down to third man for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Ooh.. that's nasty! Bowls a shortish delivery and it's climbing up on Hafeez. He hops back and looks to fend at it but takes it on the gloves and the ball goes onto hit the grill. Falls down safely on the pitch after that. That would have shaken him up again.
Bowls a length delivery outside off, Hafeez covers the line and defends it towards point.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards mid off by Hafeez.
Pat Cummins comes back on to have another go with the ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Second maiden over for Hazlewood and he has been right on the money.
On a length on middle, defended solidly.
Banged in short, Azam ducks under it.
Bowls a full length ball outside off, Azam prods forward and drives it to Hazlewood who makes a good stop on his followthrough.
Shortish delivery well outside off, played with an angled blade to Maxwell at point.
Bowls it on a length outside off, angling in. Babar is squared up a touch but defends it to the covers.

Fuller and angling down leg, it's tucked through square leg by Babar Azam. Hafeez is quick to see the fielder is a little lazy in getting to the ball so he rushes back to complete the third. Excellent running between the wicket from the Professor. Great awareness.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid on.

OUCH! That was a sharp one. Second time Hafeez has got hit on the helmet but he seems to be alright, good to see him smiling. Banged in short on off, it's sharp, it's accurate and it's climbing onto Mohammad Hafeez quickly. He goes for the big pull but misses and is hit on the side grill of the helmet. Goes behind square on the off side as a leg bye is taken.
Keeps this on the shorter side, around off, blocked off the back foot on the off side.
Back of a length delivery which is pitched outside off, steered towards backward point but for no run.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Mohammad Hafeez positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks it out back down the track.
Angling in from around off, takes the inside edge and goes off the thigh pad behind to the keeper.
Outside off, it's punched to covers presenting the full face of the bat.
Well bowled and well played. Hazlewood keeps it on a length in that off stump channel, Babar Azam presents a solid defensive shot.
Well bowled. Good, tight line from Josh Hazlewood, Babar comes ahead and meets it with a solid, straight bat.
Short and wide outside off, Mohammad Hafeez flashes his bat hard at this. Slices it aerially down to third man and picks up a single for doing so.
Length ball angling in from around off, Hafeez punches it back down towards mid on.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack.
Short of a length outside off, defended by rising to meet it. Pakistan need 140 more runs to win off 192 balls.

FOUR! Shot of the match. Beauty, as Waqar Younis says on air. Full and just around off, Babar Azam leans into the shot and punches it back down the ground. Leaves the mid on fielder no chance of stopping it as it races away to the boundary line.
Fuller length ball outside off, Azam strides forward and drives it straight to David Warner at mid off.

On a good length, outside off with not much movement on it, Hafeez rocks back and punches it through point. Faulkner from third man comes running in and puts in a good dive to stop the boundary. The batsmen take three.
Mohammad Hafeez has bruised a couple of fingers on his right hand. The physio is out now to have a look at it. Some magic spray, maybe a little taping and he should be good to go.
That one just took off. It shot off the surface from a good length and caught Hafeez high on the bat. Maybe caught his fingers too.
Back of a length well outside off, some width on offer as Babar cuts it through towards third man for a single.
Hafeez is very careful as he lets this one outside off be. Shoulders his arms to it to let it through.

FOUR! Shot. Didn't bounce much, came at a comfortable height and the stand-in Pakistan captain has dispatched that. He stands tall to this length ball and whips it hard through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length outside off, MH offers a solid back foot punch on the off side.
Another one outside off, Mohammad Hafeez lets it go past him for the keeper to collect.
Angles across a length delivery, just outside off, Hafeez plants his front foot across, covers the line well and lets it through.
Babar Azam walks across to this fuller length delivery and meets it with a straight blade. That'll be the end of the over.
Fires it full once more, outside off, Babar drives it straight to the wide mid off fielder.
On a fuller length, just around off, driven back down the track. No run taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Babar comes ahead and blocks it out rather solidly.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards widish mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Hafeez plays this square on the off side for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack now. Can he get another breakthrough quickly here?
Brings this one back in, on the pads, it's flicked to square leg to end the over.
Great delivery! Bowled on a back of a length and it comes back in a touch, there's some zip off the surface and it catches Babar Azam on the thigh pad.
Slants across a back of a length delivery, it's outside off as Babar Azam punches it off the back foot to extra cover.
Babar Azam comes out to bat.

OUT! Australia needed something and they finally get it. Lovely bowling from James Faulkner. Good length delivery just around off, it straightens up a shade after angling in initially. Sharjeel Khan looks to poke it away on the off side with a slightly open face and ends up getting a nick on it. It's a regulation catch for Matty Wade behind the stumps and that's the first wicket down for Pakistan. Just the thing the Aussies needed.
Too straight from Faulkner, easy enough for Mohammad Hafeez to flick it through mid-wicket for a triple.
Angling in on a full length, Sharjeel clips it through backward square leg for an easy single.

FOUR! The plan is clear... To attack Travis Head and not let him settle. It's tossed up around off, the Professor dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head to get another boundary to his name.
Slider coming in with the arm, it's worked to mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and flatter on the hips, it's pulled through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot. Full on middle and leg, Hafeez with some aggressive batting here. He kneels down and middles the sweep through backward square leg to send it across the ropes.
Floats this across the right-hander, there's plenty of flight on that, Hafeez presses ahead but is beaten past the outside edge.
Starts off from around the wicket and bowls it shorter on off, it's turning away as Sharjeel goes back and whips it down to long on for a single.
Travis Head is brought into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Shot. Hit that with authority. Short and angling into the body, Mohammad Hafeez swivels across and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Prods forward to this fuller length ball and keeps it out.

IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! Couldn't exactly reach it but a great effort from Matthew Wade nonethess. Short and angling down, Hafeez looks to pull it away but gloves this and it lobs behind on the leg side. Wade rushes to his left and dives at full stretch in an attempt to take it but it's too far out. It rolls away behind as two runs are taken.

On a good length and pitched outside off, Hafeez punches it towards backward point but can't beat the fielder. Glenn Maxwell positioned there reacts quickly and dives full stretch to his right to stop it. Lovely effort.
Full delivery outside off, Mohammad Hafeez plants his front foot forward and blocks it in front of covers.
Length delivery outside off, played to point for no run.
Tailing in on a bit of a fullish length, Sharjeel Khan whips this to the mid-wicket region. Gets it in the gap nicely and picks up a double for it.
Brings the wrists into play and then clips this length ball behind square on the leg side for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a good length, just around off, Hafeez gets an inside edge on the leg side for no run.
Good shot. Sharjeel leans into this full delivery and lofts it cleanly over extra cover. It won't go all the way but it's enough to fetch three runs.
Pitches this just ahead of a driving length, around off, invites Hafeez forward and makes him defend it out on the off side.
Good length delivery just outside off, Mohammad Hafeez leans ahead a touch and blocks it out from within his crease.
Short of a length pounded in hard, Hafeez gets behind the line of the ball and defends.
Back of a length delivery outside off, kept out off the back foot.

FOUR! EDGED AND OVER! Banged in short on middle and off, it's rising on Hafeez fast and he's in no control of this pull shot. The ball goes off the edge, then the helmet and then goes over the keeper's head all the way to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Full ball on the stumps, Sharjeel looks to defend but gets it off the inside edge behind square on the leg side. A single is taken.
Second Powerplay has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the circle now.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Shows intent, comes down the track and mistimes his hit over mid on. Couple taken!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Back of a length delivery, Khan looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Scurries for the single and Faulkner reaches across to it quickly but the batsmen manage to come home safely. Leg bye signalled.
Fuller length ball angling across. Sharjeel plays it with an angled bat towards short third man. The single was there for the taking but Hafeez sends him back.
James Faulkner is into the attack now.
Fullish and angling in, Hafeez strides forward and pushes it back to the bowler. The third maiden of the Pakistani innings.
On a length outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Bangs in a shortish delivery on middle, Hafeez rises up on his toes and looks to whip it but misses and is struck on the arm. The ball then falls safely down the pitch.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Hafeez doesn't fiddle with that one.
Short of a length outside off, Mohammad leaves it alone.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Bowls a full length ball and it's straight, Khan picks it up beautifully and hits it over mid-wicket for an elegant boundary.
Bangs it in short and it's climbing up on Hafeez. He looks to pull it but ends up gloving it and the ball balloons towards fine leg. Rolls across the turf and Starc keeps it down to a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length ball outside off, Hafeez lets it go through.

Brilliant effort from Starc! Straying on the pads, Mohammad gets a fine tickle on it and the ball rolls towards the fine leg boundary. Starc sprints across to his right and makes a sliding stop to keep the ball in play. The umpires check for the boundary but he is fine. Couple taken!
On a length and it's angling in, Hafeez covers the line and defends it solidly.
Banged in short this time, Sharjeel mistimes his pull to mid on. Good comeback by Cummins after conceding a boundary off his first delivery.
Fullish ball on off, defended solidly off the front foot back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
That's a ripper! Bowls a short of a length delivery and it's seaming away appreciably. Khan pushes at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Tucks him up with a shortish delivery attacking the rib-cage, Khan hops back and looks to work it away but is hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Straying on the pads, glanced with ease through fine leg for a boundary.
Pat Cummins is introduced into the attack.
Fullish delivery outside off, Hafeez comes forward and pushes it to the covers. A good over from Josh and it's a maiden.
In the channel outside off, Mohammad doesn't fiddle with it.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it calmly to the off side.
On a length outside off, left alone by the Pakistani skipper.
Similar delivery, Hafeez loses his balance as he looks to clip it across and is struck on the pads. No real appeal from the Aussies as it was heading down leg again.
Hurls in a full length and it's shaping in on middle and leg, Hafeez looks to clip but misses and is struck on the pads. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fullish on the stumps, clipped nicely through square leg and gets three runs for it.
Wide! Gets his radar wrong and bowls it wide outside off, Mohammad has nothing to do about it.
Full length ball around off, played nicely towards point where Maxwell reacts to it in a flash and hurls in a throw at the bowler's end but misses.
Hurls it full and wide outside off, Hafeez is not lured into the drive and makes a leave.
In the channel outside off, Hafeez lets it go.
Fullish and straighter on this occasion, clipped towards mid-wicket where Khawaja makes a good sliding stop.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Shot! Bowls a shortish delivery into the stumps, Khan swivels a touch and pulls it with authority through mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish ball outside off, Hafeez goes for an ambitious drive but gets an outside edge down to third man. Single taken!

A loud appeal for LBW turned down! Bowls a fullish delivery and it's curving back, Hafeez shuffles a touch and looks to clip it across but misses and is hit on the front pad. The umpire is not interested in the LBW appeal. Hazlewood has a look towards Smith and the skipper indicates that it was heading down leg.
Wide! Sprays it way outside off, swinging further down. An easy call by the umpire.
Fullish delivery angling in, Mohammad comes forward and defends it with an open face to point.
Fullish and straying on the pads, Hafeez clips it through backward square leg nicely and comes back for the second run.
Fullish delivery tailing back in sharply, Sharjeel looks to play it across but is hit on the pads. There was no appeal from the Aussies as it was clearly heading down leg.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Short of a length outside off, Khan cuts it towards cover-point. The fielder fumbles and the batsmen come back for the couple.
FOUR! Classical cover drive! Bowls a full length ball outside off, Khan lunges forward and creams it through extra cover for an exquisite boundary. That was delightful to watch!
Wide! Gets his radar wrong and slips it way down the leg side, Khan looks to clip it but fails to make any contact.
Full delivery outside off, holding its line. Khan comes forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Fullish ball on off, Khan pushes at it tentatively towards the off side.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Hafeez looks to clip it across but misses and is hit low on the pads. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down. That was going down leg.
Shortish delivery this time, Khan stands tall and pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
On a length around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
That's a peach! Bowls a back of a length delivery and seams it across Sharjeel. He camps back and pushes at it but gets beaten comprehensively.
Short and wide delivery, Khan throws his bat at it but misses.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Bowls a full delivery attacking the stumps, Mohammad comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Smith drops a sitter! He is an amazing fielder and would be kicking himself! Feeds him with a similar delivery wide outside off, Hafeez is again drawn into the drive but gets a thick outside edge towards Smith at second slip. It carries at a comfortable height to him but pops straight out from his hand. Hafeez gets a reprieve.
Loose from Hafeez! Bowls a full and wide delivery outside off, Hafeez chases it but misses.
Bowls a full length ball on off, Mohammad prods forward and defends it nicely to the off side.
Starts off with a full delivery well outside off, Hafeez doesn't flirt with that.

We are back for Pakistan's reply with the bat. It will be important for them to get off to a good start. Can they hold their nerves and pull this chase off or will they once again crumble under pressure? The hosts have a penetrative attack and it will surely test them. Mohammad Hafeez and Sharjeel Khan to open the innings. Mitchell Starc with the new ball. Here we go...
